sources.title: Wikipedia search entry for RSA 填充（PKCS#1）
sources.method: Entry-level search locator used for orientation only; specific statements are checked against the higher-tier reference and official records where available.

statement.zh: **术语**：RSA 填充（PKCS#1）（RSA Padding (PKCS#1)）。PKCS#1 规定两种加密填充：RFC 8017 §7 写明「Two encryption schemes are specified in this document: RSAES-OAEP and RSAES-PKCS1-v1_5.RSAES-OAEP is REQUIRED to be supported for new applications; RSAES-PKCS1-v1_5 is included only for compatibility with existing applications.」填充把裸 RSA 置换包装成可用的加密方案，OAEP 是新实现的必选，v1_5 只为兼容旧应用而保留。
statement.en: **Term**: RSA Padding (PKCS#1).It is registered under protocols and PKI.

statement.zh: OAEP 的价值在于可证明的强度：§7.1 说明「Assuming that computing e-th roots modulo n is infeasible and the mask generation function in RSAES-OAEP has appropriate properties, RSAES-OAEP is semantically secure against adaptive chosen-ciphertext attacks.」附录 B.1 也用同一口径处理旧原语，称 MD2、MD5 与 SHA-1 只是为了兼容旧应用才被推荐。
statement.en: It is listed because it connects concrete records, objects or procedures in protocols and PKI, not because of its name.

statement.zh: 文档给出典型用法：§7 称「A typical application is a key establishment protocol, where the message contains key material to be delivered confidentially from one party to another.」附录 C 则把参数写成硬约束，规定使用 id-RSAES-OAEP 时「parameters MUST be present and MUST be RSAES-OAEP-params」。
statement.en: Fix the object and its aliases; list the sourced dates, roles, parameters or inscriptions; state the observable output; then test the boundary.Any step without a source stops there rather than being filled with prose.

statement.zh: v1_5 填充的问题被写在 §7.2：「It is possible to generate valid RSAES-PKCS1-v1_5 ciphertexts without knowing the corresponding plaintexts, with a reasonable probability of success.This ability can be exploited in a chosen-ciphertext attack as shown in [BLEICHENBACHER].」同一节还写下实现层面的告诫「Care shall be taken to ensure that an opponent cannot distinguish the different error conditions in Step 3, whether by error message or timing.」，并说明否则对手可能「obtain useful information about the decryption of the ciphertext C, leading to a strengthened version of Bleichenbacher’s attack [BLEICHENBACHER]; compare to Manger’s attack [MANGER]」。文档并未把该填充标为已废除，只给出对策与`不推荐用于任意消息加密`的建议。
statement.en: The boundary separates a sourced fact, a model-derived relation and an unverified gap.Secondary summaries yield to primary material; unsourced dates, counts and device values stay blank.

statement.zh: 现行文本是 2016 年 11 月的 Version 2.2，头部标注「Obsoletes: 3447」且类别为 Informational；附录 D 记录演替：「Version 2.0 incorporated major editorial changes in terms of the document structure and introduced the RSAES-OAEP encryption scheme.」即 OAEP 是 2.0 版才进入 PKCS#1 的。
statement.en: Registered period: Age of Standardization.The exact date is left to the ledger; institutional placement and technical detail follow the cited sources.

- RFC 4949: Internet Security Glossary, Version 2.https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc4949。
